source_title: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari Recruitment 2026 – 501 Posts
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 501 · Posts: 12 designation(s) · Type: State Govt Department · Direct Recruitment · Mode: Online · Fee: ₹25–₹125 · Apply: 26 October 2026 to 26 November 2026 · Pay: Level-5 to Level-8 · Selection: Preliminary + Main Written Exam · Location: Uttar Pradesh
The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the detailed advertisement A-4/E-1/2026 dated 26 October 2026 for the Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari Etc. (General/Special Recruitment) Examination-2026. A total of 501 vacancies are notified across posts such as Samiksha Adhikari (Review Officer), Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Assistant Review Officer), accounts variants, Manager, Caretaker, Receptionist (Swagati) and Store Keeper in the U.P. Secretariat, UPPSC, Board of Revenue and Office of the Advocate General. Online applications open on 26 October 2026 and close on 26 November 2026. Selection is through a Preliminary Examination followed by a Main (Written) Examination; final selection is based on Main marks. Age is calculated as on 1 July 2026. Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) before applying.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
One Time Registration (OTR) at https://otr.pariksha.nic.in is mandatory; obtain an OTR number before starting the online application.
Application is accepted only after fee payment in the bank; incomplete applications or those without photo/signature are liable to be rejected.
Corrections in submitted applications are allowed only once till 3 December 2026; after that, no changes are permitted.
Hard copies of certificates are not required at the preliminary stage but must be submitted with the Main Examination application when asked.

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
Candidates who have completed 21 years and have not crossed 40 years as on 1 July 2026 (born not earlier than 2 July 1986 and not later than 1 July 2005); PH candidates up to 55 years.
Hold a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university (with specific additions such as an O Level certificate and Hindi typing at 25 wpm for most Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari posts).
Are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh for reservation benefits; others may apply but without reservation or age relaxation.
Meet marital status conditions (no more than one living wife for male candidates, or equivalent for females, unless exempted by the Governor).
Possess all required qualifications by the last date of online application (26 November 2026).

Organisation: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)
Recruitment / Exam Name: Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari Etc. (General/Special Recruitment) Examination-2026

Post(s): Samiksha Adhikari, Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari, Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Manager, Caretaker, Receptionist (Swagati), Storekeeper
Job Location: Uttar Pradesh (U.P. Secretariat, UPPSC, Board of Revenue, Office of Advocate General)

What Posts Are Available? – UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari Vacancy 2026
The notice notifies 501 vacancies (495 under General Recruitment and 6 under Special Recruitment). Numbers may increase or decrease if additional similar posts are requisitioned before the Preliminary result. Pay scales range from Level-5 to Level-8.
Category-wise breakup is printed in the notice for General and Special Recruitment (UR, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, DFF, PH, ExS, Outstanding sports persons, Female). Exact numbers vary by post; for example, Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (U.P. Secretariat) has 153 UR, 26 SC, 1 ST, 55 OBC, 26 EWS and horizontal reservations. Full tables appear in the official advertisement. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS of U.P. and horizontal categories (Female, Ex-Servicemen, PH, DFF, Outstanding sports persons of U.P.) is admissible as per rules. Non-permanent residents of U.P. do not get reservation or age relaxation.
Who Is Eligible for UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: Indian citizen (as implied by service rules and application process).
Domicile / local condition: Permanent residence in U.P. required for reservation and age relaxation benefits. Non-permanent residents of U.P. may apply but are not entitled to reservation or age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/DFF/PH/Ex-Servicemen/Outstanding sports persons.
Category scope: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS of U.P. and horizontal categories as per Govt. rules. Women candidates’ caste certificate from father’s side only is valid. Candidates claiming multiple categories get only the more beneficial concession.
Gender: No overall restriction; female reservation is horizontal.
For most Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari posts (Secretariat/Board of Revenue/UPPSC/Advocate General): Bachelor’s degree from a university established by law in India or equivalent + “O” Level certificate (DOEACC/NIELIT or equivalent) + minimum 25 words per minute Hindi typewriting (preference for English typing).
For Samiksha Adhikari (Account) and Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Account): Bachelor’s degree in Commerce with Accountancy + O Level in Computer Application + knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script.
For Manager, Caretaker, Receptionist (Swagati), Store Keeper: Bachelor’s degree (with preferential qualifications in hotel management, cookery, horticulture, accounts, store maintenance, or specific subjects for Receptionist).
Preference is also given to candidates who have served in the Territorial Army for a minimum of 2 years or hold an NCC “B” certificate.
Qualification must be held by: Last date for receipt of online application (26 November 2026).
What Is the Age Limit? (as on 01 July 2026)
Candidates must not have been born earlier than 2 July 1986 and not later than 1 July 2005 (UR). PH candidates must not have been born before 2 July 1971.
✅ A 39-year-old UR candidate born on 3 July 1986 — eligible (as on 01 July 2026).
❌ A 41-year-old UR candidate born on 1 July 1985 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Candidates must fulfil the marital status condition: male candidates with more than one wife living, and female candidates married to a person already having a wife, are ineligible unless the Governor grants exemption. Emergency Commissioned/Short Service Commissioned Officers seeking age relaxation must provide an Army certificate of extended service for rehabilitation and an undertaking to get released if selected.
Reservation: Admissible for SC/ST/OBC/EWS of U.P. as per relevant Govt. rules. Horizontal reservation for Dependents of Freedom Fighters of U.P., Female candidates, Ex-Servicemen of U.P., PH of U.P. and Outstanding sports persons of U.P. on settlement of vacancies. PH reservation only for notified/identified posts.
PwBD: Suitable sub-categories notified for specific posts (e.g., L.V., H.H., C.P., L.C., Dw., B., A.A.V., M.D.Y., O.A., O.L., M.D.). Certificate from competent medical authority countersigned by CMO required as per U.P. Public Service (Reservation for PH, DFF and Ex-Servicemen) (Amendment) Act, 2021.
State-specific categories: DFF (sons/daughters/grandsons/granddaughters), outstanding sportspersons of U.P., Skilled players of classified games of U.P.
Reservation benefits only for permanent residents of U.P.; certificates must be in prescribed proforma (Appendix-1) and submitted when asked.
The posts carry the pay scale of ₹29,200–64,700 (Level-5) to ₹47,600–1,51,100 (Level-8) as per the 7th Pay Commission structure applicable in Uttar Pradesh. Exact starting basic and in-hand salary depend on the specific post and level notified under the relevant service rules. No consolidated pay or daily wage is mentioned.
Benefits (as printed): As per relevant U.P. service rules (U.P. Public Service Commission Subordinate Service Regulations 2006, U.P. Secretariat Subordinate Service Rules 1999, etc.). No specific additional benefits listed beyond the pay scale.
Payment mode: Through bank (SBI MOPS or other prescribed modes); payment transaction slip generated after successful payment. Fee must be paid before last date; reconciliation till 3 December 2026.
The UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari online form 2026 is filled at https://uppsc.up.nic.in from 26 October 2026 to 26 November 2026.
Visit https://otr.pariksha.nic.in and complete One Time Registration if not already done.
Obtain OTR number (mandatory; process in 72 hours if new).
Open the UPPSC Online Application (Open).
Click Apply, authenticate with OTR, complete “Have You Completed Your OTR Registration?” and enter the OTR number.
Fill in personal details (auto-populated from OTR), educational qualifications, and choose Yes/No for preferential qualifications.
Upload photograph and signature as per instructions (if required at this stage).
Proceed to fee payment (Net Banking/Card); take the payment transaction slip.
Submit the application after fee confirmation; print and keep the final application form safely.
Entering the wrong category, DOB or qualification details (cannot be changed later except once in the correction window).
Failing to pay the fee before 26 November 2026 or not reconciling by 3 December 2026.
Not taking a printout of the submitted application.
Claiming reservation without having the prescribed certificate ready for later submission.
UPPSC समीक्षा अधिकारी / सहायक समीक्षा अधिकारी भर्ती 2026 – 501 पद
अंतिम तिथि: 26 नवंबर 2026 तक ऑनलाइन आवेदन।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है: 1 जुलाई 2026 को 21 से 40 वर्ष की आयु (पीएच के लिए 55 वर्ष तक), स्नातक डिग्री + ओ लेवल + हिंदी टाइपिंग 25 शब्द प्रति मिनट (अधिकांश सहायक समीक्षा अधिकारी पदों के लिए)।
आवेदन कैसे करें: https://uppsc.up.nic.in पर OTR के बाद ऑनलाइन आवेदन करें। शुल्क ₹25 से ₹125 श्रेणी अनुसार।
वेतन: लेवल-5 से लेवल-8 (₹29,200–64,700 से ₹47,600–1,51,100)।
चयन: प्रारंभिक परीक्षा (वस्तुनिष्ठ, 1/3 नकारात्मक अंकन) के बाद मुख्य लिखित परीक्षा; अंतिम चयन मुख्य परीक्षा के अंकों पर।
Preliminary Examination (objective type) at various centres in districts of U.P.
Candidates approximately 15 times the number of vacancies, are declared successful for the Main (Written) Examination.
Main (Written) Examination; selection on the basis of total marks obtained in the Main Examination.
Document verification and medical examination as per rules for selected candidates.
Negative marking: In Preliminary, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Blank questions have no penalty. Multiple answers treated as wrong.
Preliminary (Appendix-2): General Studies (objective) covering Indian History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Current Affairs, etc., plus General Hindi and specific papers as detailed.
Main (Appendix-3): Papers on General Studies I & II, Ethics and Integrity, Current Affairs, Hindi (General Hindi & Essay, Hindi Essay), Science & Technology, etc. Full unit-wise topics are printed in the advertisement.
No change in centre/venue is permissible once allotted.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This UPPSC RO/ARO Exam for You?
This is a large-scale direct recruitment for Group B/C level posts in the U.P. Secretariat and related offices, with 501 vacancies offering Level-5 to Level-8 pay. The two-stage exam (Prelims + Mains) is standard for UPPSC subordinate services, and the high number of Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari seats (especially 261 in Secretariat) makes it attractive for graduates with computer and Hindi typing skills. Age relaxation is generous for reserved categories and certain service/fellowship candidates. The main challenge is the competitive Prelims with negative marking and the need for precise documentation at the Mains stage. Suitable for candidates targeting stable U.P. government service who can clear the efficiency thresholds.

FAQs – UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari 2026
What is the last date to apply for UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari/Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari 2026?
26 November 2026 for online application and fee payment. Correction window till 3 December 2026.
What is the age limit for UPPSC Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari?
21 to 40 years as on 1 July 2026 for UR candidates (born not earlier than 2 July 1986 and not later than 1 July 2005). Relaxations apply for reserved categories of U.P.
Is there an exam for UPPSC Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari, or is it interview-based?
Yes, Preliminary Examination (objective) followed by Main (Written) Examination. Selection is based on Main marks. No interview mentioned.
What is the pay for Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari posts in this recruitment?
Pay scale ₹29,200–64,700 (Level-5) to ₹47,600–1,51,100 (Level-8).
Can final-year students apply for this recruitment?
No. Candidates must possess the required qualifications by the last date of online application (26 November 2026). Those appearing are not eligible.
Is this Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari post a permanent government job?
Yes, it is direct recruitment to permanent posts under the relevant U.P. service rules.
Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh apply?
Yes, but they are not entitled to reservation or age relaxation benefits reserved for permanent residents of U.P.
Where will selected candidates be posted?
In the U.P. Secretariat, U.P. Public Service Commission, Board of Revenue, U.P., or Office of the Advocate General, U.P., as per the post applied for and departmental requirements.
What is the negative marking in the Preliminary Exam?
One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty for blank questions.
How many candidates are shortlisted for Mains?
Approximately 15 times the number of vacancies based on the Preliminary Examination result.
